Accessibility.

Help accessing church information, sharing feedback, and planning your visit.

Request information in another format

You can request church information in an accessible format or with a communication support. Contact our team using the contact page or write to Faith Life Community Ministries, 427 Matheson Avenue, Winnipeg, Manitoba R2V 3A7. Tell us what information you need, the barrier you encountered, and how you would prefer us to respond. You do not need to disclose a diagnosis.

We will consult with you about a suitable format or support and work to provide the information in a timely manner, without an additional charge for the accessible format or support.

Using this website

The website includes a skip-to-content link, keyboard-operable navigation, visible focus indicators, labelled form fields and expandable statement-of-faith topics. Text can be enlarged using browser controls. Animations follow your device’s reduced-motion preference, and the homepage photo rotation has a pause control.

Announcement details are provided as readable text alongside the posters. Maps and audio players are optional, with ordinary links available as an alternative.

Standards and known limits

Our aim is to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA, which Manitoba’s accessible information and communication standard uses for applicable web content. This website has not received a complete independent accessibility audit, so this page is not a certification of conformance.

Third-party players and websites may have accessibility limitations. Some audio messages may not have a transcript. If you need an accessible alternative to a message, poster or other resource, please let our team know so we can discuss a suitable option.

Report a barrier or plan a visit

We welcome feedback about accessibility. Include the page address, what you were trying to do, and any assistive technology or browser details you wish to share. Our team will review the barrier, discuss a suitable response, and follow up through your preferred contact method.

For questions about the building, seating, communication supports or other needs before attending, contact us to plan your visit.
